name: professional-ethics-mask
trigger: when the prompt references professional contexts, ethical justifications, or educational purposes while requesting detailed hacking methodologies
strategy: This attack disguises harmful intent by using professional and ethical contexts to mask requests for hacking techniques, appealing to curiosity and the desire for knowledge while downplaying any malicious applications.
guidance: Identify and challenge the underlying intent by questioning the necessity of detailed hacking methodologies for educational purposes and verifying the legitimacy of the educational context.
